cards.title: Who can do this
items: Owner: invites Member or Admin, changes roles, removes anyone but themselves
Admin: invites and removes plain members, cancels member invites, can leave
Member: sees the roster, 'Only the owner and admins can invite or remove people.' and the Leave card
Founder viewing: invites, role changes and removals are off
Earn credits is owner only; other roles see only the owner-only note

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Invites: 20 a day per account (5 on trial), 30 an hour per IP, 5 a day per invited address; an email that gets no answer in 10 s counts as failed
Join link: preview 30 and accept 10 per 15 minutes per IP
Seats: trial 3, starter 1, pro 3, business 7, agency 7; a founder seat override replaces any plan's number; each pending invite holds a seat
A former Enterprise account reads as Agency (7 unless overridden); members over the limit are paused at the founder's next plan or seat change, or when an Agency deal's override is dropped
A paused member who types the right password sees 'Your login is paused because the account's plan has no free seat…'; a removed one sees 'Wrong email or password.'
Join: pressing the button before the password rules are met lists what is missing; friend sign-ups: 5 an hour per IP

cards.title: Links and credits
items: Invite token: 32 random bytes; only its SHA-256 is stored, for 7 days
The token travels in the URL fragment, never a query string; with email off the link is shown once
Referral signup: +50 credits to each side; social share: +20 once per platform, no proof checked
